title: Clinical performance and implant stability of cement versus implant-retained and/or supported prostheses: A randomized controlled trial
html: While implant-retained and/or supported mandibular prostheses have become an essential prosthetic alternative in complete edentulism, the biological response of implants supporting different digitally produced prostheses has not been thoroughly compared regarding the effect of 3-dimensionally (3D) printed overdentures versus milled fixed prostheses on implant stability and clinical indices.
